Its three-dimensional detailing and elegant restraint make it a truly distinctive timepiece. Like a Small Sculpture Unlike the printed or applied indexes commonly found on mass-produced watches, these indexes are engraved deeply into the dial itself. As light moves across the surface, the engravings cast subtle shadows, revealing a rich sense of depth. The dial transforms with every change of light, much like a small sculpture rather than a flat surface. This ever-changing expression adds quiet richness to the wearer’s day. Traditional Japanese Kanji Numerals - The Beauty of Japanese Writing, Revived Through Time Traditional Japanese Kanji numerals for 壱, 弐, 参 (one, two, three), once used in official documents during Japan’s Taishō era, were symbols of trust and dignity. In this timepiece, their beauty is revived through delicate engraving, with every line and stroke meticulously carved into the dial. Classic yet refreshingly modern, these characters give the watch a quiet presence and evoke the feeling of wearing a small piece of historical heritage on the wrist. Volcanic Pattern Dial The dial features a finely textured volcanic-pattern finish that subtly reduces light reflection. This delicate texture not only minimizes glare but also adds a balanced sense of depth and quiet luxury to the surface. The result is a calm, refined elegance with a subtle antique character, allowing the dial’s expression to change gently with the light. Combining high precision, durability, and a beautifully fluid seconds motion, this movement truly represents the heart of a serious timepiece, delivering performance and elegance in equal measure. Domed sapphire glass The watch is fitted with a domed sapphire crystal, a highly refined material commonly used in luxury timepieces and optical applications. Its exceptional clarity enhances dial legibility, while its superior scratch resistance far exceeds that of standard mineral glass. High-Quality Genuine Leather Strap The strap is crafted from high-quality genuine cowhide leather with a crocodile-embossed pattern. Its subtle sheen adds a refined, luxurious touch, while the leather develops a richer character and patina with wear over time. Practical and High-Quality Deployant Clasp The leather strap is fitted with a refined double-fold deployant clasp that offers a clean, luxurious appearance. Commonly used on high-end timepieces, this clasp reduces stress on the leather when putting the watch on or taking it off, helping preserve the strap over time. It also provides a secure, stable fit on the wrist, minimizing the risk of accidental release while enhancing everyday comfort.
